purpose: Generate a sensor-observable correction of the sealed C01-C08 spatial event Teacher by applying only the frozen 16-line LiDAR vertical FOV while retaining every observation and event identity.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-2 C01-C08 observable Teacher V2 export; apply only the fixed [-15,+15] degree vertical FOV filter; zero C09/C10/M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed automatic best-choice execution without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 spatial multi-event Teacher V1 with native-mesh LOS labels.

worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Retain every sealed observation. For each active Teacher token compute atan2(up,horizontal); retain iff the elevation is within the inclusive frozen LiDAR FOV [-15,+15] degrees, then repack in original distance/identity order.

teacher.source: Sealed native-mesh-LOS spatial event Teacher V1 corrected only by the fixed LiDAR vertical FOV.
teacher.valid_mask: V2 event_mask is V1 event_mask intersected with inclusive target elevation [-15,+15] degrees; padding is repacked and zero-event rows retained.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: V2 remains teacher-only. Student deployment receives no identity, world, pose or filter flag; future graph edges remain execution-verified.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Formal inputs bind only sealed C01-C08 Teacher V1. Historical C09 field-name/shape exposure is quarantined and contributes no value, statistic or decision.
split.fit: C01-C06 retains 98279 tokens after removing 1213 vertical-FOV tokens.
split.selection: C07-C08 retains 33145 tokens after removing 418 vertical-FOV tokens.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only transformation of 80 small sealed Teacher shards; no mesh, scan, checkpoint or model access.

failure_policy: Any count, identity, order, source, FOV, split or leakage mismatch fails closed; do not alter FOV, delete rows or inspect model errors inside the run.
